text: Follow the Starlight.
Which light is a star?
Ari knows three lights from their first journey. Dot finds one light that makes its own glow.
Planets shine with sunlight. Stars make their own light.
Unknown light found. Mission accepted!
Which point is our Sun from far away?
From far away, even our enormous Sun becomes one tiny point among the others.
There is no visual clue. Our Sun is a star that looks big because it is close.
What keeps a star steady?
Gravity pulls inward. Pressure from the hot core pushes outward. A steady star needs both.
Gravity pulls in. Pressure from the hot core pushes out. A steady star needs both.
Which star is our middle-sized Sun?
Stars come in many sizes. Our Sun sits between tiny red dwarfs and enormous giants.
This is our Sun. Some stars are much smaller, and some are hundreds of times wider.
Which star is hottest?
Star colour is evidence. Blue-white stars are hotter than red stars—the opposite of many taps.
Blue-white stars are hotter than red stars.
